data.action: 蜷坐于壁橱软垫上，头戴耳机专注看吉他谱
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 壁橱秘密基地】逼仄而充满安全感的卧室壁橱里，四壁贴满了喜爱的摇滚乐队海报与暖黄色小串灯。波奇酱蜷坐在软垫上，头戴专业监听耳机，怀抱吉他专注练琴，眼神温柔又安心——「这里是属于我一个人的安全岛……只有吉他和录音麦克风，不用担心任何人的目光。」
data.lighting: 暖黄串灯微光与电脑屏幕冷光交融
data.promptProse: Hitori curls on a cushion inside her bedroom closet recording nook, practicing guitar beneath large monitor headphones in a baggy pastel T-shirt and lounge shorts. Rock posters cover the close walls around the eye-level medium view, with the recording microphone beside her instrument. Warm string lights touch her pink hair and fingertips, while cool computer glow defines the guitar's near edge and the deeper folds of her relaxed clothes.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 壁橱秘密基地
